mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as it signals improved labor market conditions and potential growth.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 3.5% in the next 30 days, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDP demand (GDPC1) and business demand (RSAFS) proxies signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through expanded investment opportunities.
failure_condition: The correlation between GDPC1 and RSAFS does not exceed 0.7 over the 60-day horizon, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals accommodative monetary policy supporting equity valuations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% during the 20-day period, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation spike above 2% in the CPIAUCSL series triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates and reduced profit margins.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not cross above 2% in the next 5 days, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both payroll employment (PAYEMS) and GDP demand (GDPC1) proxies signals robust labor market and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through expanded corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The combined effect of PAYEMS and GDPC1 does not result in a correlation >0.5 over 20 days, or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in GDP demand (GDPC1) coupled with a sustained drop in supply indicators (INDPRO) below 100 signals tight demand-supply conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through upward pressure on asset prices.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show a sustained decline below 100 over the 60-day horizon, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE below 2%) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 3.5%) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as policy accommodation and labor market recovery boost investor confidence.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 2% and FEDFUNDS does not drop below 3.5% within the next 20 days, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
